_doc: DEWY decision receipts for the 2026-08-09/10 Yuri-family session, dogfooding runtime/specs/dewy-receipt-schema-v1.json (core fields). Hand-filed, not compass-generated. See ADR-044 for the headline decision.

receipts.sharp_question: How do we stop ARCS stating aspirational capabilities as present fact?

dewy_vector.D: Capability claims carry temporal placement (NOW/NEXT/ASPIRATIONAL); fiction = not-NOW; enforce by a gate that refuses to write unhedged aspiration.
dewy_vector.W: DURABLE (extends ADR-039). Revisit when ARCS ships a genuinely model-agnostic runtime.

receipts.true_north: ARCS runs on Claude today; a Google-internal version could run on Gemini. Never render aspiration as present fact.
receipts.why: The model-agnostic false claim was aspiration leaking into the present tense with nothing to catch it; a technical counterpart catches what we miss.
receipts.loki: Could this false-positive a legit hedged claim? Mitigated by Agentum-exception + generous hedge window + tuneable lists.
receipts.bar: A false capability claim to a builder inverts trust (whole-relationship ruin). Gate caught a 2nd live instance (Robin) on first run.

receipts.sharp_question: Given the full LinkedIn thread, does the artifact family fit Yuri's actual vibe?

dewy_vector.D: Refit to a warm, bite-size, no-agenda reader who bounces off abstraction: redact the profile (dossier) from the send, collapse the menu to two (before/after + diamond), warm the entry, and open by telling him what it is in his terms (a pre-meeting brief, closed and scored).
dewy_vector.E: yuri.html + facesnav; profile page kept live but unlinked.
dewy_vector.W: This-send tactical (per-recipient), grounded in his verbatim 'high level and theoretical / how do I use this'.

receipts.true_north: For a warm no-agenda guy who told you it was too abstract, give one clear thing, not a universe.
receipts.why: He said twice it was too abstract and asked for how-to-read / who-for / an example; the read-of-himself was the hardest to judge.
receipts.loki: Does redacting the profile lose the 'read of you' value? No — he asked for the before/after of the CALL, not a portrait of himself.
receipts.bar: Over-building for a busy bite-size reader = he bounces and never gets to the good part.

receipts.sharp_question: Would a full-manifold diamond-cut recoil of the call be valuable, or an overclaim?

dewy_vector.D: Ship the diamond cut as EARNED-fidelity, not maximal: 2 defensible dimensions (Sync + self-scored Conviction), verbatim-anchored, the gap-between-lines is the read, resolution said out loud, fence intact; surface it for the builder (the closed-loop 'after' he never built), not the front door for everyone.

receipts.true_north: Render only what one call honestly supports; depth is a gift, not a flex.
receipts.why: A full 12D manifold off one 30-min call self-refutes against earned-fidelity/refusal-to-overclaim; two honest dimensions do not.
receipts.loki: Is it a fancy chart or the real thing? Verbatim-anchored + self-scored + fence = earned, per all gauntlet facets.
receipts.bar: A pixel-precise chart implies measurement it does not have; mitigated by rounding to 5-pt steps + a loud fidelity fence.

receipts.sharp_question: Before sending a counterpart artifact, how do we catch what the register/lens gauntlet misses?

dewy_vector.D: Run a 6-facet counterpart-persona simulation (builder/practitioner/skeptic/connector/hedge/bite-size) + an adversarial verifier that rejects over-flags, grounded in the primary transcript + memory; verify each surviving flag against source before healing.
dewy_vector.W: DURABLE method for pre-send QA of any counterpart family.

receipts.true_north: The deepest check is BEING the counterpart across facets at high burden of proof; neither detector nor register-lens gauntlet is enough alone.
receipts.why: It caught framing/mechanism cracks (buyer-relabeling, the ratchet, chart chronology conflict) the lens + register gauntlets passed clean.
receipts.loki: Over-flagging risk? The verifier rejected 4 over-flags (e.g. 'two lines are really one'); I re-verify each against source.
receipts.bar: Self-review is the weakest check; a builder catches hand-waving in 2s.
